page.overview:
Who is Cassio the Tilean?

Cassio the Tilean was a Tilean thief who dared to steal from the Amethyst College of Altdorf and was cursed for this crime for the rest of his life, and perhaps beyond...

The doors of the Amethyst College are always slightly ajar, yet few thieves dare to cross its shadowed threshold. One who did was Cassio the Tilean, who, twenty years ago, stole forty silver shillings and a brooch from the college. Though he quickly spent the money, he found no buyer for the brooch.

Soon after, tragedy struck -- his wife perished in a freak accident that left him blind, and he was soon afflicted with a terrible wasting disease. Shunned by his remaining family, he became a beggar. Those who gave him alms found themselves plagued by misfortune and eventually stopped helping him.

Convinced the brooch was cursed, Cassio sought to return it. He spent years crawling through the streets of Altdorf, desperately trying to find his way back. His pitiful cries for directions became infamous throughout the city. But he never reached his destination.
